title: Films, music, sport & free time
goal: Recommend and review films, series and songs, follow and discuss a cricket or hockey match, talk about your hobbies — and compare everything: better, far better, the best ever, the more the better.
intro:
Most chats between friends end up here: the new Odia film everyone's talking about, the series you're bingeing, the song stuck in your head, last night's match. In Odisha that means cricket — but also **hockey**, which the state lives and breathes: Bhubaneswar's Kalinga Stadium has hosted two men's Hockey World Cups.

The grammar is all about **comparing**, building on unit 8's ଠାରୁ 'than' and ସବୁଠାରୁ 'most': **ଢେର ଭଲ** 'far better', **ଆହୁରି** 'even more', **ତୁଳନାରେ** 'compared with', **ସମାନ** 'the same', 'not as good as', 'one of the best', 'the best I've *ever* seen' (**ମୁଁ ଦେଖିଥିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ**), and 'the more…, the more…' with **ଯେତେ … ସେତେ**. Plus the slang word every young Odia uses for 'awesome': **ଫାଟାଫାଟି**.

vocab.note: Very common among young people: ସିନେମା ଫାଟାଫାଟି! Not for formal situations.
Feeling bored: ମୋତେ ବୋର୍ ଲାଗୁଛି. The Odia word is ବିରକ୍ତିକର.

vocab.en: web series, a show (on a streaming app)

vocab.note: Formal Odia: ସମୀକ୍ଷା.
Actress: ଅଭିନେତ୍ରୀ. In speech the lead is often just ହିରୋ / ହିରୋଇନ୍.
Colloquially also ଷ୍ଟୋରି.
A woman singer is ଗାୟିକା (gayika).
ମୁଁ ଗାଏ, ସେ ଗାଆନ୍ତି (resp.); ତୁ-command ଗା.
ଆହୁରି ଭଲ = even better.
ଢେର ଭଲ = far better; ଢେର ସମୟ = loads of time.
After the noun: ଗତ ବର୍ଷ ତୁଳନାରେ 'compared with last year'.

vocab.en: as much / as many as; (with ସେତେ) the more…
vocab.note: Relative partner of ସେତେ: ଯେତେ … ସେତେ = the more … the more.
Also on its own: ସେତେ ଭଲ ନୁହେଁ 'not that good'.
Partner: ସେତିକି 'that much'.
Field hockey — Odisha's great sporting passion.
ଗୋଲ୍ କରିବା = to score a goal.
In speech also ଟିମ୍.
The news word; in speech mostly କ୍ୟାପ୍ଟେନ୍.
Used for awards and in writing: ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ଅଭିନେତା. In speech: ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ.
… ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଜଣେ / ଗୋଟିଏ = one of the …
ମୋର … ସଉକ ଅଛି = I'm into …

phrases.en: You have to watch it — it's really good. (familiar)

phrases.native: ଆଜି ରାତିରେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଅଛି, ଏକାଠି ଦେଖିବା?
phrases.roman: aji ratire myach ôchhi, ekaṭhi dekhiba?
phrases.en: There's a match tonight — shall we watch it together?

phrases.native: ଏହା ମୁଁ ଦେଖିଥିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ସିନେମା।
phrases.roman: eha muṃ dekhithiba sôbuṭharu bhôlô sinema.
phrases.en: This is the best film I've ever seen.
What do you do in your free time?

grammar.title: Comparing in depth: far better, even better, the same, not as good as
grammar.body:
Unit 8 gave you **ଠାରୁ** 'than' and **ସବୁଠାରୁ** 'most'. Arguing about films and teams needs more shades. Remember that Odia adjectives never change — there is no '-er'; the comparison lives in the little words around them.

**'Than'**: X**ଠାରୁ** is the everyday form. **X ଅପେକ୍ଷା** means the same and sounds a little more formal; **X ତୁଳନାରେ** is 'compared with X': ଗତ ବର୍ଷ ତୁଳନାରେ ଏ ବର୍ଷ ଦଳ ଭଲ ଖେଳୁଛି.

**How much better**: **ଟିକେ** 'a bit' · **ବହୁତ** or colloquial **ଢେର** 'much, far' · **ଆହୁରି** 'even': ବହି ସିନେମାଠାରୁ **ଢେର** ଭଲ 'the book is far better than the film', ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ସିଜନ୍ **ଆହୁରି** ଭଲ 'season two is even better'.

**Like / the same**: X **ପରି** 'like X' (ସେ ଧୋନୀ ପରି ଖେଳେ); **ସମାନ** 'equal, the same' (ଦୁଇଟା ପ୍ରାୟ ସମାନ).

**As … as / not as … as**: either X **ପରି** + adjective + ନୁହେଁ — ନୂଆ ଗୀତ ପୁରୁଣା ଗୀତ **ପରି** ଭଲ **ନୁହେଁ** 'the new songs aren't as good as the old ones' — or the relative pair **ଯେତିକି … ସେତିକି** 'as much … as': ମୁଁ **ଯେତିକି** ଭାବିଥିଲି, ସିନେମା **ସେତିକି** ଭଲ ନୁହେଁ 'the film isn't as good as I'd thought'. On its own, **ସେତେ ଭଲ ନୁହେଁ** means 'not that good'.

The trap: don't add ବେଶି to every comparison. ଏହା ତାଠାରୁ ଭଲ already means 'this is better than that'. Use ବେଶି for amounts — ବେଶି ରନ୍ 'more runs', ମୋଠାରୁ ବେଶି ସିନେମା ଦେଖେ 'watches more films than me'.

examples.en: The book is far better than the film.

examples.native: ଗତ ବର୍ଷ ତୁଳନାରେ ଏ ବର୍ଷ ଦଳ ଭଲ ଖେଳୁଛି।
examples.roman: gôtô bôrsô tuḷônare e bôrsô dôḷô bhôlô kheḷuchhi.
examples.en: Compared with last year, the team's playing well this year.

examples.native: ମୁଁ ଯେତିକି ଭାବିଥିଲି, ସିନେମା ସେତିକି ଭଲ ନୁହେଁ।
examples.roman: muṃ jetiki bhabithili, sinema setiki bhôlô nuheṃ.
examples.en: The film isn't as good as I'd thought.

examples.native: ନୂଆ ଗୀତ ପୁରୁଣା ଗୀତ ପରି ଭଲ ନୁହେଁ।
examples.roman: nua gitô puruṇa gitô pôri bhôlô nuheṃ.
examples.en: The new songs aren't as good as the old ones.

grammar.title: The best, one of the best, the best ever
grammar.body:
**The best / the most**: **ସବୁଠାରୁ** + adjective (lit. 'than all'): ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଖେଳାଳି 'the best player', ସବୁଠାରୁ ଖରାପ 'the worst', ସବୁଠାରୁ କମ 'the least/fewest'. Formal Odia — awards, news, speeches — uses **ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ** 'best': ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ଅଭିନେତା ପୁରସ୍କାର 'best actor award'.

**In / of a group**: put the group in **-ରେ** or **ମଧ୍ୟରେ**: ଦଳ**ରେ** ସେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ 'he's the best in the team'.

**One of the best**: superlative + plural noun in the possessive + **ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଜଣେ** (a person) / **ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ** (a thing): ସେ ଭାରତର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଖେଳାଳି**ମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଜଣେ** 'he's one of India's best players'. Casually people just say ସେ ଜଣେ ବେଷ୍ଟ ଖେଳାଳି.

**The best … I've ever seen**: Odia has no 'ever' here — use the **-ଇଥିବା** participle from unit 20 before the noun: ମୁଁ **ଦେଖିଥିବା** ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ସିନେମା 'the best film I've seen'. Add **ଜୀବନରେ** 'in my life' for emphasis: ମୁଁ ଜୀବନରେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ ସୁନ୍ଦର ଗୀତ.

The trap: there's no word for 'the' and no double superlative — ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ is already 'the best'; don't add ବେଶି.

examples.en: He's the best player in the team.

examples.native: ସେ ଭାରତର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ହକି ଖେଳାଳିମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଜଣେ।
examples.roman: se Bharôtôrô sôbuṭharu bhôlô hôki kheḷaḷimanôṅkô môdhyôru jôṇe.
examples.en: He's one of India's best hockey players.

examples.native: ଏହା ମୁଁ ଜୀବନରେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ ସୁନ୍ଦର ଗୀତ।
examples.roman: eha muṃ jibônôre suṇithiba sôbuṭharu sundôrô gitô.
examples.en: It's the most beautiful song I've ever heard.
He won the best actor award.

grammar.title: The more…, the more…: ଯେତେ … ସେତେ
grammar.body:
Odia builds 'the more …, the more …' with the relative pair **ଯେତେ … ସେତେ** (lit. 'as much as …, that much …') — one of the ଯ- / ସ- pairs from unit 20:

**ଯେତେ** ଶୁଣିବ, **ସେତେ** ଭଲ ଲାଗିବ 'the more you listen, the more you'll like it'.

The ଯେତେ half holds the cause (usually future, present or habitual), the ସେତେ half the result. With adjectives: **ଯେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର, ସେତେ ଭଲ** 'the sooner the better'; ଯେତେ ଲୋକ, ସେତେ ମଜା 'the more the merrier'. Add ବେଶି / କମ when it's about amounts: ଯେତେ ବେଶି ଖେଳିବ, ସେତେ ଭଲ ଖେଳାଳି ହେବ.

**ଯେତିକି … ସେତିକି** is the 'quantity' version, 'as much as': ଯେତିକି ପାରିବ ସେତିକି ଖାଅ 'eat as much as you can', ଯେତିକି ଦରକାର ସେତିକି ନିଅ 'take as much as you need'.

The trap: keep both halves. English 'the more… the more' has one word repeated; Odia needs the **ଯେ-** word first and the **ସେ-** word second — swapping them or dropping ସେତେ sounds broken.

examples.en: The more you listen, the more you'll like it.

examples.native: ଯେତେ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ କରିବ, ସେତେ ଭଲ ଖେଳିବ।
examples.roman: jete ôbbhyasô kôribô, sete bhôlô kheḷibô.
examples.en: The more you practise, the better you'll play.
Eat as much as you can.

dialogue.title: Film or hockey?
dialogue.setting: Bhubaneswar, a Friday evening. Jyoti wants to see the new Odia film on Sunday; her friend Bapi has other plans.

lines.speaker: Jyoti
lines.native: ବାପି, ରବିବାର କ'ଣ କରୁଛୁ? ନୂଆ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ସିନେମା ଆସିଛି, ରିଭ୍ୟୁ ଫାଟାଫାଟି!
lines.roman: Bapi, rôbibarô kôṇô kôruchhu? nua Oṛia sinema asichhi, ribhyu phaṭaphaṭi!
lines.en: Bapi, what are you doing on Sunday? The new Odia film's out — the reviews are amazing!

lines.speaker: Bapi
lines.native: ରବିବାର? କଳିଙ୍ଗ ଷ୍ଟାଡିୟମରେ ହକି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଅଛି ନା! ଭାରତ ବନାମ ଅଷ୍ଟ୍ରେଲିଆ।
lines.roman: rôbibarô? Kôḷiṅgô sṭaḍiyômôre hôki myach ôchhi na! Bharôtô bônamô Ôsṭrelia.
lines.en: Sunday? There's the hockey match at Kalinga Stadium! India versus Australia.

lines.speaker: Jyoti
lines.native: ପୁଣି ହକି? ତୁ ଗତ ମାସରେ ତ ଦୁଇଟା ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଦେଖିଲୁ।
lines.roman: puṇi hôki? tu gôtô masôre tô duiṭa myach dekhilu.
lines.en: Hockey again? You watched two matches last month!

lines.speaker: Bapi
lines.native: ଆରେ, ଏଇଟା ସାଧାରଣ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ନୁହେଁ। ଅଷ୍ଟ୍ରେଲିଆ ଦୁନିଆର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଦଳମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ।
lines.roman: are, eiṭa sadharôṇô myach nuheṃ. Ôsṭrelia duniarô sôbuṭharu bhôlô dôḷômanôṅkô môdhyôru goṭie.
lines.en: Come on, this isn't just any match. Australia are one of the best teams in the world.

lines.speaker: Jyoti
lines.native: ଆଉ ଏହା ଏ ବର୍ଷର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ସିନେମା ବୋଲି ସମସ୍ତେ କହୁଛନ୍ତି। ହିରୋର ଅଭିନୟ ତାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଥମ ସିନେମାଠାରୁ ଢେର ଭଲ।
lines.roman: au eha e bôrsôrô sôbuṭharu bhôlô sinema boli sômôste kôhuchhônti. hirorô ôbhinôyô taṅkô prôthômô sinemaṭharu ḍherô bhôlô.
lines.en: And everyone's saying this is the best film of the year. The hero's acting is way better than in his first film.

lines.speaker: Bapi
lines.native: ସେ ହିରୋ? ତା' ଅଭିନୟ ଆଉ ମୋ ଅଭିନୟ ପ୍ରାୟ ସମାନ!
lines.roman: se hiro? ta ôbhinôyô au mo ôbhinôyô prayô sômanô!
lines.en: That hero? His acting and mine are about the same!

lines.speaker: Jyoti
lines.native: ହା ହା, ଈର୍ଷା! ଗୀତ ବି ବହୁତ ଭଲ। ମୁଁ ସକାଳୁ ସେଇ ଗୀତଟା ଦଶ ଥର ଶୁଣିଲିଣି।
lines.roman: ha ha, irsa! gitô bi bôhutô bhôlô. muṃ sôkaḷu sei gitôṭa dôsô thôrô suṇiliṇi.
lines.en: Ha ha, you're jealous! The songs are great too. I've played that one song ten times since this morning.

lines.speaker: Bapi
lines.native: ଯେତେ ଶୁଣୁଛୁ, ସେତେ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ପଶୁଛି, ନା?
lines.roman: jete suṇuchhu, sete muṇḍôre pôsuchhi, na?
lines.en: The more you listen, the more it gets stuck in your head, right?

lines.speaker: Jyoti
lines.native: ଠିକ୍! ଆଚ୍ଛା, ଗୋଟେ କାମ କରିବା: ସଞ୍ଜ ଛଅଟାରେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍, ତା'ପରେ ରାତି ନଅଟାର ସୋ।
lines.roman: ṭhik! achchha, goṭe kamô kôriba: sôñjô chhôṭare myach, tapôre rati nôṭarô so.
lines.en: Exactly! OK, let's do this: the match at six, then the nine o'clock show.

lines.speaker: Bapi
lines.native: ଫାଟାଫାଟି ଆଇଡିଆ! କିନ୍ତୁ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଲମ୍ବା ହେଲେ?
lines.roman: phaṭaphaṭi aiḍia! kintu myach lômba hele?
lines.en: Brilliant idea! But what if the match runs long?

lines.speaker: Jyoti
lines.native: ହକି ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ପ୍ରାୟ ଡେଢ଼ ଘଣ୍ଟା, କ୍ରିକେଟ୍ ପରି ସାରା ଦିନ ନୁହେଁ!
lines.roman: hôki myach prayô ḍeṛhô ghôṇṭa, krikeṭ pôri sara dinô nuheṃ!
lines.en: A hockey match is about an hour and a half — not all day like cricket!

lines.speaker: Bapi
lines.native: ହଉ, ପକ୍କା। ଟିକଟ ମୁଁ ବୁକ୍ କରୁଛି — ଯେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର, ସେତେ ଭଲ।
lines.roman: hôu, pôkka. ṭikôṭô muṃ buk kôruchhi — jete sighrô, sete bhôlô.
lines.en: Fine, it's a deal. I'm booking the tickets — the sooner the better.

culture:
Odisha is India's **hockey state**. The Odisha government has sponsored the national men's and women's teams since 2018, Bhubaneswar's Kalinga Stadium hosted the Men's Hockey World Cup in 2018 and (with Rourkela) in 2023, and the tribal belt of Sundargarh district has produced a long line of India players. A home match fills the stadium with drums and Odia chants — and tickets go fast, so **ଯେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର, ସେତେ ଭଲ**. Cricket is just as loved: Cuttack's Barabati Stadium hosts internationals, and office conversations stop for the last overs.

The Odia film industry, nicknamed *Ollywood*, is based in Cuttack and Bhubaneswar; new releases are discussed on social media in a happy mix of Odia and English, and many people watch on streaming apps, including Odia ones. Music runs from film songs to **Sambalpuri** hits from western Odisha — songs like *Rangabati* get every wedding and college fest dancing — to classical Odissi music. Villages still love **jatra**, travelling folk theatre with all-night shows.

Young people's slang for 'brilliant' is **ଫାଟାଫାଟି** (lit. something like 'bursting'); also heard: ବଢ଼ିଆ 'great', ବେକାର 'useless, rubbish', and a lot of English — ଓସମ୍, ବୋରିଂ, ଓଭାରରେଟେଡ୍. Mixing is normal with friends; with elders, stick to ବହୁତ ଭଲ.

tip.title: Awesome or boring?
tip.body:
- Loved it: **ଫାଟାଫାଟି!** (slang) · ବହୁତ ଭଲ · ବଢ଼ିଆ.
- Didn't: **ବୋରିଂ**; I'm bored: **ମୋତେ ବୋର୍ ଲାଗୁଛି**.
- Recommend with the command + **ନିଶ୍ଚୟ**: ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଦେଖ (ତୁମେ), ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ଦେଖ୍ (ତୁ).
- English words fit straight in: **ରିଭ୍ୟୁ, ୱେବ୍ ସିରିଜ୍**.

lessons.title: Far better, even better: comparing films and songs

tip.title: Better, far better, not as good
tip.body:
- Than: X**ଠାରୁ**; compared with: X **ତୁଳନାରେ**.
- Far better: **ଢେର** ଭଲ; even better: **ଆହୁରି** ଭଲ.
- Not as good as: X **ପରି** ଭଲ **ନୁହେଁ**.
- Adjectives never change, and ଭଲ alone already means 'better' after ଠାରୁ.

sentences.native: ଏହି ସିନେମାର ଗୀତ ପ୍ରଥମ ସିନେମାଠାରୁ ଢେର ଭଲ।
sentences.roman: ehi sinemarô gitô prôthômô sinemaṭharu ḍherô bhôlô.
sentences.en: The songs in this film are far better than in the first one.

sentences.native: ତାଙ୍କ ଅଭିନୟ ଆହୁରି ଭଲ ହୋଇଛି।

sentences.en: His acting has got even better.

sentences.native: ଗତ ସିନେମା ତୁଳନାରେ ଏହାର କାହାଣୀ ଭଲ।
sentences.roman: gôtô sinema tuḷônare eharô kahaṇi bhôlô.
sentences.en: Compared with the last film, this one's story is better.

sentences.native: ଅଭିନେତା ଭଲ, କିନ୍ତୁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶକଙ୍କ କାମ ଖରାପ।

sentences.native: ଏହି ଗାୟକଙ୍କ ପୁରୁଣା ଗୀତ ନୂଆ ଗୀତଠାରୁ ଭଲ।

sentences.en: This singer's old songs are better than the new ones.

sentences.native: ତାଙ୍କ ଅଭିନୟ ତାଙ୍କ ବାପାଙ୍କ ପରି ଭଲ ନୁହେଁ।
sentences.roman: taṅkô ôbhinôyô taṅkô bapaṅkô pôri bhôlô nuheṃ.

sentences.roman: mo bhai moṭharu bôhutô besi sinema dekhe.

sentences.roman: ehi gitôṭa au thôre suṇiba.
sentences.en: Let's listen to this song one more time.

lessons.title: Following a match

tip.title: Match talk
tip.body:
- **ସ୍କୋର କେତେ ହେଲା?** · **କିଏ ଜିତୁଛି?**
- Cricket: **ରନ୍**, **ଉଇକେଟ୍** — ଚାରି ଉଇକେଟରେ ଜିତିଲା 'won by four wickets'.
- Hockey and football: **ଗୋଲ୍ କରିବା** 'to score'.
- 'Have already made': **-ଲାଣି** — ଦୁଇ ଶହ ରନ୍ କଲାଣି.

new: ଆଜି ରାତିରେ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ଅଛି, ଏକାଠି ଦେଖିବା?

sentences.native: ସ୍କୋର କେତେ? ଭାରତ ଦୁଇ ଶହ ରନ୍ କଲାଣି।
sentences.roman: skor kete? Bharôtô dui sôhô rôn kôlaṇi.
sentences.en: What's the score? India have made two hundred runs.

sentences.en: There are three wickets left.

sentences.en: Ten more runs needed to win!

sentences.roman: Bhubôneswôrôre hôki myach dekhibaku jiba?

sentences.roman: ebe kie jituchhi, ame na semane?

sentences.en: I was even checking the score on my phone in the meeting.

lessons.title: The best player, the best film ever

tip.title: The best, one of the best, the best ever
tip.body:
- The best: **ସବୁଠାରୁ** ଭଲ (formal: **ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ**).
- One of the best: … ଖେଳାଳିମାନଙ୍କ **ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଜଣେ** (thing: ଗୋଟିଏ).
- The best I've ever seen: ମୁଁ **ଦେଖିଥିବା** ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ …
- No double superlatives — ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ is already 'the best'.

new: ଏହା ମୁଁ ଦେଖିଥିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ସିନେମା।

sentences.native: ଦଳରେ ଅଧିନାୟକ ହିଁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଖେଳାଳି।

sentences.en: The captain really is the best player in the team.

sentences.native: ସେ ଦୁନିଆର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଖେଳାଳିମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଜଣେ।
sentences.roman: se duniarô sôbuṭharu bhôlô kheḷaḷimanôṅkô môdhyôru jôṇe.
sentences.en: He's one of the best players in the world.

sentences.native: ଏହା ମୁଁ ଦେଖିଥିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍।
sentences.roman: eha muṃ dekhithiba sôbuṭharu bhôlô myach.
sentences.en: This is the best match I've ever seen.

sentences.native: ଓଡ଼ିଶାରୁ ଭାରତ ହକି ଦଳକୁ ବହୁତ ଖେଳାଳି ଯାଇଛନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: Oṛisaru Bharôtô hôki dôḷôku bôhutô kheḷaḷi jaichhônti.

sentences.native: ସେ ବର୍ଷର ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ଖେଳାଳି ପୁରସ୍କାର ପାଇଲେ।
sentences.roman: se bôrsôrô sresṭhô kheḷaḷi purôskarô paile.
sentences.en: She won the player of the year award.

sentences.native: ଏ ବର୍ଷ ଆମ ଦଳ ସବୁଠାରୁ କମ ମ୍ୟାଚ୍ ହାରିଛି।
sentences.roman: e bôrsô amô dôḷô sôbuṭharu kômô myach harichhi.

sentences.native: ଏହା ମୁଁ ଜୀବନରେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଖରାପ ଗୀତ!

sentences.roman: tumô môtôre sôbuṭharu bhôlô Oṛia sinema keuṃṭa?
sentences.en: In your opinion, which is the best Odia film?

tip.title: ଯେତେ … ସେତେ — the more … the more
tip.body:
- **ଯେତେ** + cause, **ସେତେ** + result: ଯେତେ ଶୁଣିବ, ସେତେ ଭଲ ଲାଗିବ.
- Short form: **ଯେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର, ସେତେ ଭଲ** 'the sooner the better'.
- Amounts: **ଯେତିକି … ସେତିକି** 'as much as'.
- Keep both halves, ଯେ- first.

sentences.native: ଏହି ସିରିଜ୍ ଯେତେ ଦେଖିବୁ, ସେତେ ଭଲ ଲାଗିବ।
sentences.roman: ehi sirij jete dekhibu, sete bhôlô lagibô.
sentences.en: The more of this series you watch, the more you'll like it.

sentences.native: ଯେତେ ବେଶି ଖେଳିବ, ସେତେ ଭଲ ଖେଳାଳି ହେବ।
sentences.roman: jete besi kheḷibô, sete bhôlô kheḷaḷi hebô.
sentences.en: The more you play, the better a player you'll become.

sentences.native: ଟିକଟ ଯେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର କିଣିବା, ସେତେ ଶସ୍ତା ମିଳିବ।
sentences.roman: ṭikôṭô jete sighrô kiṇiba, sete sôsta miḷibô.
sentences.en: The sooner we buy the tickets, the cheaper they'll be.

sentences.native: ପିଲାମାନେ ଯେତେ ବଡ଼ ହେଉଛନ୍ତି, ସେତେ କମ କଥା ହେଉଛନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: pilamane jete bôṛô heuchhônti, sete kômô kôtha heuchhônti.
sentences.en: The older the kids get, the less they talk.

sentences.native: ଟିକଟ ଯେତିକି ଦାମୀ, ସିନେମା ସେତିକି ଭଲ ନୁହେଁ।
sentences.roman: ṭikôṭô jetiki dami, sinema setiki bhôlô nuheṃ.
sentences.en: The film isn't worth what the ticket costs.

sentences.native: ତୁମକୁ ଯେତିକି ଦରକାର, ସେତିକି ନିଅ।

sentences.en: Take as much as you need.

sentences.native: ଦୁଇ ଦଳ ପ୍ରାୟ ସମାନ, କିଏ ଜିତିବ କହି ହେବ ନାହିଁ।
sentences.roman: dui dôḷô prayô sômanô, kie jitibô kôhi hebô nahiṃ.
sentences.en: The two teams are about equal — there's no telling who'll win.

sentences.native: ଟିକଟ ବୁକ୍ କରିଦିଅ, ଯେତେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ସେତେ ଭଲ।
sentences.roman: ṭikôṭô buk kôridiô, jete sighrô sete bhôlô.
sentences.en: Book the tickets — the sooner the better.

sentences.native: ମୋ ପାଇଁ ଦୁଇଟା ଗୀତ ସମାନ, ଦୁଇଟା ଭଲ।
sentences.roman: mo paiṃ duiṭa gitô sômanô, duiṭa bhôlô.
sentences.en: To me the two songs are the same — both good.

tip.title: Talking about hobbies
tip.body:
- I'm into …: **ମୋର** + (-ବାର / noun-ର) + **ସଉକ ଅଛି** — ଗୀତ ଗାଇ**ବାର** ସଉକ.
- Free time: **ଫୁରସତ** — ଫୁରସତ ମିଳିଲେ 'when I get time'.
- Habits use the simple present (ପଢ଼େ, ଖେଳେ); 'used to' -ଉଥିଲି.

sentences.native: ମୋର ଫଟୋ ଉଠାଇବାର ସଉକ ଅଛି।
sentences.roman: morô phôṭo uṭhaibarô sôukô ôchhi.
sentences.en: I'm into photography.

sentences.native: ଫୁରସତ ମିଳିଲେ ମୁଁ ବହି ପଢ଼େ।
sentences.roman: phurôsôtô miḷile muṃ bôhi pôṛhe.
sentences.en: When I get some free time, I read.

sentences.native: ସେ ବହୁତ ଭଲ ଗାଆନ୍ତି।
sentences.roman: se bôhutô bhôlô gaônti.
sentences.en: She sings really well.

sentences.native: ପାର୍ଟିରେ ଗୋଟେ ଗୀତ ଗା ନା!
sentences.roman: parṭire goṭe gitô ga na!
sentences.en: Come on, sing a song at the party!

sentences.native: ଛୁଟି ଦିନ ମୁଁ ସାଙ୍ଗମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ହକି ଖେଳେ।
sentences.roman: chhuṭi dinô muṃ saṅgômanôṅkô sôhô hôki kheḷe.
sentences.en: On my days off I play hockey with friends.

sentences.native: ଏତେ କାମ, ଫୁରସତ କେଉଁଠି?
sentences.roman: ete kamô, phurôsôtô keuṃṭhi?
sentences.en: So much work — what free time?

sentences.native: ତୁମର କ'ଣ ସଉକ?
sentences.roman: tumôrô kôṇô sôukô?
sentences.en: What are your hobbies?

sentences.native: ଛୋଟବେଳେ ମୁଁ ବହୁତ ଗାଉଥିଲି, ଏବେ ସମୟ ନାହିଁ।

sentences.en: I used to sing a lot as a kid; now there's no time.
